## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
The code includes automated tests (unit tests or assertion checks that values compute as expected), and their coverage is measured and reported (e.g. with covr in R).
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
Tests or assertion checks exist but their coverage is not measured or reported, or they cover only a small part of the code.
:::
::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" title="Not met"}
The code contains no tests.
:::

[Based on: [#70](../../sources.qmd#p70 "The Stark realities of reproducible statistically orientated sociological research: Some newer rules of the sociological method") 'if you did not check the code coverage of your tests, fail'; [#131](../../sources.qmd#p131 "Guide for Accelerating Computational Reproducibility in the Social Sciences") adding unit tests (if/then checks every \~100 lines).]{.source-note}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Not applicable"}
Never.
:::
